item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The graph shows how many books a class returned on four days.

Which conclusion is justified by the graph?

options.A: Tuesday has the tallest bar, so more books were returned on Tuesday than on any other labelled day.
options.B: The vertical axis is labelled Books, so the answer is the word Books.
options.C: Wednesday shows about $8$ books even though the scale marks are every $5$ books.
options.D: Books cause Tuesday to be busier than Monday.
